fixed.what: promote.mjs planRevert now reads every line of a card, not only the last one. The card's own reliance comes from its latest checker-confirmed card-item line, and only while the card is confirmed now. A sentence clearing is any confirmed sentence-check line that names the class. Each counts only when no later unqualified-revert names the class. One revert line is written per card, with status witnessed only when the card's own confirmation relies on the class, else the current status. The earlier agent made the code change and I checked it. I updated spec/promote.mjs.md step 2 and added T12c/T12d to it. CONTRACT 3.15 still says witnessed; see lib_change_requests.
fixed.test_added: promote.test.mjs T12c and T12d. Both fail on the pre-fix promote.mjs. T12d also catches the mutation where every revert line is witnessed.

fixed.what: commit.mjs urlEvidence counts only these as R34 evidence: the WebFetch access.urls; the result text of WebFetch, WebSearch and Agent calls; and the structured results of helper transcripts. Never Write/Edit/Bash inputs, Read results, a WebFetch prompt, a search query, or the session's own StructuredOutput. harvest.mjs no longer takes the session's own structured output as a candidate. The earlier agent made both changes. I added a fallback: when a tool use carries no access record, urlEvidence takes the URLs from lib.toolAccess. This changes nothing with the current parser. Specs updated: commit step 5 and harvest candidates.
fixed.test_added: commit.test.mjs X5. It fails pre-fix, and five single-route mutations are each caught by X5. harvest.test.mjs X2 fails pre-fix.

fixed.what: commit.mjs keepParents (fixpoint): a pack or review parent must be stored or accepted in the same intake. A parent rejected in that run gives fk-parent. A parent left unstored for want of a transcript defers the child. The earlier agent made the change. I updated spec/commit.mjs.md step 6, which used to say 'a stored pack'.

not_fixed.why: By the spec, a harvested card (a helper's structured result) is stored with origin harvested and never URL-checked. A helper's structured result also counts as R34 evidence for a session card. So a session can still get a card with an unfetched URL through by having a helper return it. Closing this is a spec decision: URL-check harvested cards against fetch/search evidence in the helper's own transcript. That also needs the full tool-result text from the library (see lib_change_requests). The witness (R25) stays the backstop.

lib_change_requests: lib.parseTranscript cuts tool-result text at 2,000 characters. R34 evidence for a URL past that cut in a WebSearch or WebFetch result is lost, so a card whose URL really was found gets rejected url-not-in-transcript. Request: add r.urls to each tool result, holding the http(s) URLs found in the full text (bounded count), so commit can check against them.

Not the library: CONTRACT.md 3.15, for its owner. It says every revert line has status witnessed. promote now writes witnessed only when the card's own card-item confirmation relies on the class; a line that only reopens a sentence clearing keeps the current status (review U2-F1). Suggest amending 3.15 to match; spec/promote.mjs.md step 2 already says this.
